note: The OXware catalog is curated by the maintainer. To share a plugin, post it in GitHub Discussions; if it is broadly useful and safe, it will be added here.

apps.name: Hello World Plugin
apps.description: Minimal example plugin: adds /api/plugin/hello route. Great starting point for developers.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Telegram Notifier
apps.description: Forwards VM lifecycle events (created, started, stopped, failed) and high-severity alerts to a Telegram bot.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Discord Console
apps.description: Manage VMs from a Discord channel via slash commands: /vms, /start, /stop, /reboot, /status.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Prometheus Exporter
apps.description: Exposes OXware host and VM metrics at /metrics in Prometheus exposition format. Suitable for scraping by Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Mimir.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: PagerDuty Alerter
apps.description: Routes high-severity OXware alerts to PagerDuty Events API v2. Maps severity, deduplicates by alert key.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Slack Notifier
apps.description: Posts OXware events to a Slack channel via incoming webhook. Filters by severity and category.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: WordPress Production Stack
apps.description: Ubuntu 22.04 + nginx + MariaDB + PHP-FPM + WordPress, tuned for production. cloud-init bootstraps Let's Encrypt and basic hardening.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: k3s 3-Node Cluster
apps.description: Three-VM k3s cluster — one server, two agents. cloud-init joins agents via shared token. Includes Traefik ingress.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Monitoring Stack (Prometheus + Grafana + Loki)
apps.description: Single-VM monitoring host running Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Promtail. Preconfigured to scrape the OXware Prometheus Exporter plugin.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Mail Server (Postfix + Dovecot + Roundcube)
apps.description: Self-hosted mail with TLS, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, Roundcube webmail, Fail2Ban. cloud-init asks for the domain and admin email.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: WireGuard VPN Server
apps.description: WireGuard server with a small client management API. cloud-init generates the server keypair and exposes a QR-code endpoint for new client configs.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: vSphere Look
apps.description: UI theme that mimics VMware vSphere Client colors and typography. Drop-in CSS, no panel changes.
apps.author: OXware

apps.name: Backblaze B2 Backup Target
apps.description: Adds Backblaze B2 as a backup destination for the OXware backup scheduler. Supports application-default encryption and lifecycle rules.
apps.author: OXware
